entries.name: Cinco de Mayo
entries.capsule: A 1862 Mexican military victory, celebrated on St. Paul's West Side with a large parade, car show, music and food.
entries.dateRule: May 5. The West Side celebration is held on a nearby weekend announced each year by organizers.

dates.source: Sahan Journal describes the fifth of May holiday
Sahan Journal describes the fifth of May holiday
Sahan Journal describes the fifth of May holiday

entries.whatItMarks: A Mexican military victory in 1862. Sahan Journal notes it carries little significance in Mexico itself.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: On St. Paul's West Side since 1985, hosted by West Side Boosters and the West Side Fiestas Committee, with a parade on Cesar Chavez Street from Wabasha to Ada, a car show and music. About 30,000 attended in 2025. In 2026 organizers debated holding it during the federal enforcement surge and went ahead on a smaller footprint.

minnesotaEvents.name: West Side Cinco de Mayo Parade & Festival
minnesotaEvents.organizerDates: Parade and festival Sat., May 2, 2026, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.; car show Fri., May 1, 2026, at Harriet Island. No 2027 date announced.

entries.name: Mexican Independence Day
entries.capsule: Mexico's independence, begun in 1810, marked in St. Paul with a West Side celebration since at least 1939.
entries.dateRule: September 16. West Side Fiestas holds its celebration on a date it announces each year.

dates.source: MPR News names Sept. 16 as Mexican Independence Day
MPR News names Sept. 16 as Mexican Independence Day
MPR News names Sept. 16 as Mexican Independence Day

entries.whatItMarks: Start of the 1810 war of independence.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: St. Paul's first Fiestas Patrias in 1939 paraded from the West Side downtown. In 1886 a visiting Mexican military band led an Independence Day parade in Minneapolis. West Side Fiestas held a 2026 celebration with car show, music, vendors, crafts, a kids' zone and a community march.

minnesotaEvents.name: Mexican Independence Day Celebration
minnesotaEvents.organizerDates: Sat., Sept. 12, 2026, as announced. No 2027 date announced.

entries.name: Día de la Virgen de Guadalupe
entries.capsule: Feast of Mexico's patron, with a one-mile procession and Masses at St. Paul's diocesan shrine.
entries.dateRule: December 12, often beginning the evening before.

dates.source: The Catholic Spirit states the Dec. 12 feast day
The Catholic Spirit states the Dec. 12 feast day
The Catholic Spirit states the Dec. 12 feast day

entries.whatItMarks: The 1531 appearance of the Virgin Mary reported by Juan Diego.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Our Lady of Guadalupe in St. Paul, a diocesan shrine since 2019, holds an annual one-mile procession; about 700 attended the eve Mass in 2019. Past celebrations include Church of the Risen Savior in Burnsville in 2014 and Misión El Santo Niño Jesús, an Episcopal church in St. Paul, in 2003. No 2026 schedule was found.

minnesotaEvents.name: Annual procession and feast Masses
minnesotaEvents.place: Our Lady of Guadalupe, 401 Concord St., St. Paul
minnesotaEvents.organizerDates: 2019 held Dec. 11 and 12; 2026 schedule not found

entries.name: Día de los Muertos
entries.capsule: Families remember those who have died with altars, flowers and gatherings; Twin Cities events cluster around Nov. 1.
entries.dateRule: November 1 and 2 by custom; UNESCO gives only the end of October to the beginning of November. Minnesota events fall on nearby days announced by organizers.

entries.name: Feast of San Pablo
entries.capsule: Families from Axochiapan, Morelos, honor their patron saint in Minneapolis with Masses, a street procession, dance and food.
entries.dateRule: January 25, with Minneapolis festivities around that date. Local dates are set each year.

dates.source: Diario Las Américas gives Jan. 25 as the feast

entries.whatItMarks: The conversion of St. Paul, patron saint of Axochiapan.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Reported in 2020 as two days of Masses, a street procession, dance and tamales with mole at Incarnation/Sagrado Corazón in south Minneapolis, with about 1,200 taking part. No 2026 report was found.

minnesotaEvents.organizerDates: Photos dated Jan. 24, 2020; no 2026 date found

entries.name: Farmworkers Day
entries.capsule: Minnesota's 2026 proclaimed day honoring farm labor, replacing Cesar Chavez Day after allegations against Chávez.
entries.dateRule: March 31 in 2026 by governor's proclamation. Whether it recurs depends on future proclamations.

dates.source: FOX 9 reports the proclamation

entries.whatItMarks: Farmworkers and the farm labor movement.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: The governor proclaimed it for March 31, 2026, after lawmakers repealed Cesar Chavez Day. West Side and school leaders spoke in support of the change. No public celebration was found.
